lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters in approximately four longitudinal rows along the lateral flank, extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern, most prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Strong linear feature on the upper flank with a sharp vertical gradient, appearing as a high-intensity dorsal edge with a corresponding low-intensity shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-resolution high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, rectangular anthropogenic attachment (satellite transmitter) positioned on the dorsal midline immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters at the distal terminations of the superior and inferior caudal fin lobes.
